name: Cat Face Mug
snippet: For the cat person who wants everyone to know it.
story: I sculpt and paint each one of these individually, trying to capture that look cats have perfected — slightly amused, slightly judgmental, entirely themselves. These are for the people who want everyone to know exactly where their loyalties lie. A cup that looks back at you.
details_text:
☕ Size: Standard mug, ~12 oz
🎨 Style: Hand-sculpted cat face, hand-painted glaze
🍽️ Safety: Food safe, dishwasher safe
⏱️ Turnaround: ~6 weeks
📦 Shipping: Carefully packed, ships nationwide
